notes: Enemy numbers come from the community wiki (slaythespire.wiki.gg), which is edited by players and can lag behind patches.

Beta patches v0.108.0 to v0.111.0 were checked; enemy changes in them (Soul Fysh, Axebot, Mecha Knight, Exoskeleton, Globe Head, Louse Progenitor, Entomancer, Aeonglass, Torch Head Amalgam, encounter-order rules) are reflected here.
Ascension values: the wiki usually lists HP changes at A8 and damage changes at A9. Each value records the level it applies from.
Character tips are reasoned from the listed mechanics, not play-tested. Treat them as prompts to think, not rules.
